# Launch Screen Assets

`LaunchImage{,@2x,@3x}.png` are generated by `tools/launch/render.py` (run
from `flutter_app`): the title block of the Flutter loading screen, drawn the
same way, centred by `LaunchScreen.storyboard` on the app's cream. Regenerate
them there rather than editing the files; Android's copies
(`res/drawable-*dpi/launch_image.png`) come from the same script.
